notes.title: Update Notes for May 11
notes.content:
v0.12.00 (Early Access)
- Modifying base model at vehicle editor. 
- "Magic" Axles from vehicle to wheels.
- Wheel buttons affected by x1, x5, x20.
- Modified showroom lighting.
- Cam presets system Improved. 
- Distance between vehicles now is border to border. 
- More vehicle information shown at cloud garages.
- Minor buxes fixed.

notes.title: Update Notes for Apr 26
notes.content:

- Rim meshes improved.
- Pryde Rod improved.
- Sukko Buggy improved.
- Some cloud garages problems solved.

notes.title: Update Notes for Mar 25
notes.content:
v0.04.00 (Early Access)
- "Player is Auto" mode.
- Can modify values faster when editing a car.
- Distance and time handicaps for Free Mode races.
- Options > Input Settings  (Controls rebinding).
- Day time clock while driving.
- 1-hour precision at Configure Race (Free Mode).
- Important bugs fixed at Cloud Garages.
- Other minor bugs fixed.
